responsibility: Defines regression tests for the nonstandard_style module’s CamelCase name handling, validating both detection of compliant identifiers and normalization of noncompliant inputs via `is_camel_case` and `to_camel_case`.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` is scoped to the `nonstandard_style` submodule and checks that module’s CamelCase classification and rewriting helpers. Unlike the top-level `src/tests.rs`, it is not about general lint-name parsing infrastructure used across the crate.
